lead.title: AMD acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion, enters spatial intelligence race
lead.summary: AMD makes its biggest AI bet yet, acquiring the spatial intelligence startup founded by renowned AI researcher Fei-Fei Li. The all-stock deal brings World Labs' 3D scene understanding technology under AMD's umbrella, with Li joining as EVP and chief scientist. The acquisition signals AMD's intent to compete directly with Nvidia in spatial AI and physical AI markets.

top_stories.title: Viral AI agent Instinct raises $1B Series C at $10B valuation
top_stories.summary: The consumer AI agent platform for booking, purchases and research closed a $1B round led by Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Coatue, reaching a $10B valuation.

top_stories.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 delivers 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at 30% lower cost
top_stories.summary: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family scores 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (up from 10.3% on Sonnet 5), runs 30% faster, and costs up to 30% less per task at the same $2M input token pricing.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA launches Open Agent Safety Platform with 100+ industry partners
top_stories.summary: NVIDIA's open platform combines OpenShell runtime software and Sentry DPU-based hardware watchdog to secure AI agents from testing to deployment, backed by Anthropic, Microsoft, SpaceXAI and Cisco.

top_stories.title: CargoX raises $250M for driverless delivery network in UAE
top_stories.summary: The autonomous delivery startup closed a $250M growth round led by BlueFive Capital, with Mubadala and Toyota Ventures participating, to expand its driverless robot fleet.

items.title: Frontier Learning: training LLM reasoners at the edge of capability
items.summary: Proposes training LLM reasoners on problems at the edge of their capability rather than a fixed pool, using GRPO with adaptive difficulty selection to improve reasoning generalization.

items.title: How to Loop MoE: flatten the experts, untie the attention
items.summary: Bridges looped Transformers (reusing one block multiple times) with sparse mixture-of-experts to push fixed-size models further while activating only a few experts per token.

items.title: Distillation defenses easily break after reinforcement learning
items.summary: Demonstrates that existing distillation defenses against model stealing are easily circumvented when the attacker applies RL to the distilled model, recovering frontier-level performance.

items.title: VEX-Bench: benchmarking verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation
items.summary: Benchmark measuring the verification difficulty of LLM-generated misinformation, quantifying the asymmetry between cheap content production and expensive fact-checking.

items.title: Behavioral foundation models for quality diversity
items.summary: Proposes Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) for RL, analogous to LLMs in NLP, demonstrating zero-shot performance, fast imitation and online adaptation from diverse behavior trajectories.

items.title: Universal Robots introduces Generation 7 cobot platform for physical AI
items.summary: UR's Gen 7 refresh includes tool-flange Ethernet/power/I/O ports, plant-scale managed-switch networking, built-in safety controller, CB7 controller and external ROS2 AI compute support for the factory floor.

items.title: AMD Gorgon Halo AI mini-PC launches with 192GB unified memory
items.summary: GMKtec launched the Evo-X5 Pro mini-PC with AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495, 192GB LPDDR5X-8533 unified memory at 273 GB/s, and up to 120W sustained TDP, enabling local 320B-parameter LLM inference from $6,399.

items.title: Faraday Future FF Master humanoid deployed at Los Angeles dental clinic
items.summary: Faraday Future's FF Master humanoid handles front-desk patient check-in, appointment lookup and wayfinding at Wonderful Life Dental Group, communicating in 50+ languages in the first real-world healthcare deployment of the platform.

items.title: Meta launches Enterprise AI Platform, hires ex-MongoDB CEO to lead
items.summary: Meta launched a new enterprise AI initiative bringing its models, agents and infrastructure to businesses, hiring MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead what aims to become Meta's third major business pillar.

items.title: PIP: an AI buddy that lives on your computer
items.summary: A personal AI assistant that lives locally on your computer, launched as the #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt for September 28.

items.title: Vantage.ai: see and control what your coding agent does
items.summary: Developer tool providing visibility and control over coding agent behavior, letting developers monitor and manage AI coding agent actions in real time.

items.title: Cuey: compare ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini answers side by side
items.summary: Browser tool that shows responses from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in a single tab for direct comparison, with 255 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Harmony: AI agents that resolve IT and HR tickets in Slack and Teams
items.summary: AI agents that automatically resolve IT and HR support tickets directly inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, with 136 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: SiMa.ai raises $150M Series C at $1.45B valuation for physical AI chips
items.summary: AI chip startup SiMa.ai closed a $150M round co-led by Fidelity and Amplify for energy-efficient chips running AI on robots, drones and cameras without cloud dependency.

items.title: Maritime AI startup Quartermaster raises $140M Series B
items.summary: The maritime intelligence company closed a $140M Series B led by Insight Partners at roughly $200M valuation for AI-enabled sensors and analytics targeting defense and shipping sectors.

items.title: Outmarket raises $34.5M Series B to automate insurance sales with AI
items.summary: AI-driven insurance broker platform for small businesses closed a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire.
